earned_qualities: Localized practical pools distinguish warm check-in/office work from cooler inspection and subdued storage.
Major routes and functional machinery remain visible; no dominant flat even lighting or geometry-hiding darkness.
Ceiling fixtures visibly affect nearby structure, and contact shadows ground desk, chair, trolley, scanner and conveyor.
Small status lights and amber beacons remain restrained; bright paper, cloth and practical fixtures do not bloom across the composition.
Subdued exposure, dark overhead structure and dim storage establish an active coercive institutional mood with controlled depth.
